about: The 2020 Census population of the district each state legislative contest of 2022 is held in, by D3's contest id (data/state-upper/2022, data/state-lower/2022), as the Census Bureau tabulates it to the state legislative districts of the 2022 election cycle. Nothing is apportioned: a contest whose district the Bureau does not tabulate gets no figure, with the reason. The fields are described in data/README.md (data/population/).

census_cd118.name: U.S. Census Bureau, 2020 Census 118th Congressional District Summary File (CD118), v. 2023-08-31: the geographic header's POP100 for state legislative districts of the 2022 election cycle (summary levels 610 and 620)
census_cd118.licence: a work of the U.S. Government (17 U.S.C. 105); no licence printed
census_cd118.note: one zip per state, its geographic header file read by pipeline/intake/census_sld_population.py (read 2026-11-07T11:52Z to 2026-11-07T11:57Z); POP100 is the 2020 Census count of 1 April 2020 ("Population Count (100%)"); each file's url and sha256 under files. Technical documentation: https://www2.census.gov/programs-surveys/decennial/2020/technical-documentation/complete-tech-docs/118th-congressional-district-summary-file/2020census-118thcongressional-districts-techdoc.pdf
